name: Responsibility in the Engineering Profession
description:
On the one hand, the successful implementation of an engineering project is essentially based on technical expertise. On the other hand, a wide range of other competencies, such as efficient project management, goal-oriented personnel management, conflict management, etc., are necessary, for example, to successfully implement a construction project operationally. Social competencies, i.e. ethical values such as trust, responsibility, mutual recognition of rights and obligations, etc., which also contribute significantly to the success of an engineering project, are often overlooked. In addition to a legal anchoring, these normative concepts also contain moral-ethical contents, ethical norms and values, which will be presented and systematically elaborated in this interdisciplinary introductory seminar and tested on practical case studies, i.e. a successful realization of construction projects.
All participants are expected to give one (group-) presentation during the course.
prerequisites: NO special philosophical knowledge is necessary!
